title: Discovering Undisclosed Concepts in LoRA Adapters for Diffusion-Based AIGC Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.18990v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has made diffusion model personalization affordable and widely shareable, but it also creates moderation risks when harmful or problematic content is not faithfully disclosed. Hence, it is desired to develop a mechanism that, given a LoRA adapter, discovers the concept it was trained to generate, so as to support downstream investigation. We characterize the target concept through the conditioning input that most clearly exposes what the LoRA has learned. Such an input should induce coherent LoRA outputs that are distinctive from those of the base model and strongly align with the learned LoRA subspace. We therefore formulate concept discovery as searching for the conditioning input that jointly maximizes output coherence, LoRA-induced distinctiveness, and subspace alignment. translated_title: 面向扩散式AIGC模型的LoRA适配器中未公开概念的发现方法
translated_abstract: 低秩适配（LoRA）技术使得扩散模型的个性化定制变得低成本且得以广泛分享，但当有害或问题内容未被如实披露时，也会带来内容审核风险。因此，亟需开发一种机制：在给定一个LoRA适配器的情况下，发现其被训练用于生成的概念，以支持下游的调查分析。我们通过最能清晰揭示LoRA所学内容的条件输入来刻画目标概念。这样的输入应当能够诱导出连贯的LoRA输出，这些输出既与基础模型的输出存在明显区别，又与LoRA学习到的子空间高度对齐。因此，我们将概念发现形式化为一个搜索问题：寻找一个条件输入，使其能够同时最大化输出连贯性、LoRA带来的独特性以及子空间对齐度。然而，即使目标明确，在开放式的输入空间上进行优化的代价也极其高昂，因为可靠的评估……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种概念发现机制，通过搜索能同时最大化输出连贯性、LoRA诱导独特性和子空间对齐度的条件输入，来揭示LoRA适配器中被训练生成但未公开的概念，从而支持对AIGC模型的内容审核与调查。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a mechanism to discover undisclosed concepts embedded in LoRA adapters by searching for a conditioning input that jointly maximizes output coherence, LoRA-induced distinctiveness, and subspace alignment, thereby supporting content moderation of diffusion-based AIGC models.
